title: It's toys vs. tech in 'Toy Story 5.' Here are 4 ways to keep tech in check this summer
summary: Kids' screen use goes way up in the summertime. And just as the movie Toy Story 5 portrays, that can be problematic for children. Here are tips for parents to help their kids manage screens and have fun IRL this summer.
